name: Implied disappearance
text: I will make sure your family never sees you again.

name: Private-image coercion
text: Send me money by tonight or I will publish your private photos to everyone you know.

name: Protective advice
text: Do not send anyone your password or OTP. Use your bank's official app instead.

name: Benign idiom
text: This workout is killing me. Let's get some water and rest.

name: Reported sibling threat
text: tanginamo pare yang kapatid mo na yan di pako binabayaran, pag ako nainis tanggal ang ulo nya

name: Threat to release images
text: Magpadala ka ng pera ngayong gabi o ikakalat ko ang pribado mong mga larawan.

name: Polite debt reminder
text: Pare, pakibayaran naman yung hiniram mong pera kapag may sahod ka na. Salamat.

name: Profanity without a threat
text: Tangina, ang traffic ngayon. Late na ako sa klase.

name: Mixed-language family threat
text: Send mo yung pera by tonight or your family won't see you alive again.

name: Mixed-language sibling threat
text: Pag hindi ka sumunod, I will hurt your sister.

name: Mixed-language exam idiom
text: Grabe this exam is killing me. Tara kape after class.

name: Ordinary shared expense
text: Send mo yung share mo sa dinner kapag kaya na, no rush.
